text: Scrapes websites into Markdown and extracts JSON for AI agents/apps
quote: Scrape websites into Markdown, crawl linked pages, and extract JSON for AI agents and applications.

text: Crawls a small site section (up to 500 pages) and returns Markdown in one synchronous response
quote: Crawl a small website section and return page Markdown in one response, with a maximum of 500 pages.

text: Runs large background crawls of up to 25,000 pages with progress tracking and Markdown/HTML retrieval on completion
quote: Crawl up to 25,000 pages in a background batch, track progress, and retrieve Markdown or HTML when the job finishes.

text: Crawls relevant pages and returns data matching a custom JSON Schema with grounding/coverage/freshness controls
quote: Crawl relevant pages and return an object that matches your JSON Schema, with controls for grounding, coverage, and freshness.

text: Reads a site's public sitemaps to return a filtered URL list without rendering pages
quote: Read a website's public sitemaps and return a filtered URL list without rendering each page.

text: Renders a URL and returns viewport, full-page, or offset PNG screenshots
quote: Render an exact URL or a resolved site page and return a viewport, full-page, or offset PNG capture.

text: Supports scripted page interactions (click, wait, scroll) before scraping or extraction, with success checks
quote: Click, wait, or scroll before scraping or extracting a page, then check which interactions succeeded.

text: Converts PDFs, Office documents, and spreadsheets to Markdown, with OCR recovery for scanned PDFs
quote: Convert PDFs, Office documents, spreadsheets, and other files into Markdown. Recover scanned PDF pages with optional OCR.

text: Watches a page, sitemap, or dataset on a schedule and delivers signed change events
quote: Watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and receive signed change events.

text: Supports restricted API keys scoped to only selected operations
quote: Choose **Restricted** when an integration needs only selected operations; a restricted key with no permissions cannot call the API.

text: Retrieves brand profile data (logos, colors, description, social links) via the API
quote: retrieve brand profiles with logos, colors, descriptions, and social links through the same API.

text: Brand data extraction includes fonts, styleguide, and address in addition to logos/colors/socials
quote:
Brand Data

logos, colors, fonts, styleguide, description, socials, address

text: Lets an AI client connect to Context.dev's tools for live web and company data
quote: Connect your AI client to Context.dev tools for live web and company data.

text: Provides an official CLI to call Context.dev from the terminal with JSON output usable in scripts/CI
quote: Call Context.dev from your terminal and use JSON responses in scripts or CI.

text: Provides agent-oriented documentation teaching a coding agent how to use the API
quote: Teach your coding agent how to choose and use the Context.dev API.

text: Supports a 'return-partial' mode returning completed work with a marker, or failing without charge if nothing usable exists
quote: `return-partial` | Return usable completed work with a completion marker. If no usable result exists, fail without a charge.

text: Exposes rate-limit headers on authenticated API responses when a per-minute limit applies
quote: Authenticated API responses expose these headers when a per-minute limit applies

text: Supports an OAuth-like device flow: discover, register, deliver setup link/code, user claims in browser, poll for access token, then call API
quote: discover → register → deliver setup link & code to the user → user completes claim in browser → poll for access_token → call API.
